source: synthetic; text of word-style-export.pdf with Word Symbol-font glyphs restored
notes: What PDF.js returns for a Word-exported PDF: the Symbol-font bullet arrives as U+F0B7 and a Symbol space as U+F020 (Private Use Area). Same resume as word-style-export.pdf, whose Edge-rendered bullets come through as a plain middle dot instead. Before the fix these rendered as empty boxes on every bullet and in the export, and the unrecognised bullet let wrapped lines be read as new entries.
